mapper.select: SELECT RULE_ID ruleId, RULE_NAME ruleName FROM RSK_RULE_INFO

select RULE_ID ruleId, CLASSIFY_DIMENSION classifyDimension, CLASSIFY_DIMENSION_VAL classifyDimensionVal, LINK_SIGN linkSign from RSK_RULE_POOL_CONFIG where RULE_ID = #{ruleId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by PARAM_NUM

SELECT T1.IND_ID indId, T1.IND_NAME indName, T1.IND_TYPE indType, T1.SUP_TYPE supType, T1.WARN_COND warnCond, T1.FOUL_COND foulCond, T1.APPROVE_COND approveCond,
T1.INSTITUTION_CODE institutionCode
FROM RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR T1
T1.IND_ID NOT IN (SELECT IND_ID FROM RSK_RULE_INDICATOR WHERE RULE_ID = #{ruleId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
AND T1.IND_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{indName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
AND T1.IND_TYPE = #{indType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND T1.SUP_TYPE = #{supType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
